title: Clinical Data Management Associate – Fresher Only
description:
**Job Summary:** 




 The Clinical Data Management Associate supports the collection, review, cleaning, validation, and management of clinical trial data to ensure it is accurate, complete, consistent, and compliant with applicable clinical research standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Support clinical data management activities for clinical trials.
* Perform data review, validation, and discrepancy identification.
* Assist with EDC (Electronic Data Capture) systems and clinical databases.
* Review eCRFs/CRFs for completeness, consistency, and accuracy.
* Generate and resolve data queries in coordination with clinical sites and study teams.
* Assist with data cleaning, reconciliation, and quality checks.
* Support database setup, testing, and data validation activities.
* Perform reconciliation of clinical data with laboratory, safety, and other external data sources.
* Maintain accurate documentation and study\-related records.
* Follow SOPs, GCP, CDISC, and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Coding, Pharmacovigilance, and other project teams.
* Support database lock and study close\-out activities.



  





**Eligibility** 




 \* B.Pharm / M.Pharm
 



 \* B.Sc / M.Sc Life Sciences
 



 \* Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Microbiology
 



 \* Clinical Research or related disciplines
 



 \* Fresh graduates and candidates with 0–2 years of experience may apply.

title: Search Engine Optimization Analyst
description:
We are looking for an experienced and results\-driven SEO Specialist/Analyst to join our team.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in managing SEO campaigns,
 



 analyzing website performance, identifying opportunities for organic growth, and implementing
 



 effective SEO strategies across multiple projects.
 



 The candidate should be capable of independently managing SEO activities and working closely
 



 with content and development teams to ensure successful implementation.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 ● Develop and execute effective SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, rankings,
 



 traffic, and conversions.
 



 ● Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities.
 



 ● Perform detailed On\-Page SEO audits and implement recommendations across
 



 websites.
 



 ● Optimize meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, URLs, internal linking,
 



 images, and other on\-page elements.
 



 ● Manage and resolve Technical SEO issues, including crawling, indexing, redirects,
 



 canonical tags, sitemap, robots.txt, structured data, and Core Web Vitals.
 



 ● Conduct regular SEO audits and website health checks and provide actionable
 



 recommendations.
 



 ● Implement and manage Local SEO activities, including Google Business Profile
 



 optimization and local keyword strategies.
 



 ● Analyze website performance using Google Search Console and GA4 and identify areas
 



 for improvement.
 



 ● Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and other SEO KPIs.
 



 ● Prepare and present monthly SEO performance reports with insights and
 



 recommendations.
 



 ● Work closely with content writers and developers to implement SEO recommendations.
 



 ● Identify low\-performing pages and develop strategies to improve their organic traffic and
 



 search visibility.
 



 ● Monitor algorithm updates and industry trends and adjust SEO strategies accordingly.
 



 ● Manage multiple SEO projects simultaneously and ensure activities are completed within
 



 deadlines.
 



 ● Identify and troubleshoot SEO issues independently and provide practical solutions.
 



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 ● 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in SEO.
 



 ● Strong expertise in On\-Page, Technical, Off\-Page, and Local SEO.
 



 ● Proficiency in Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 (GA4\).
 



 ● Experience using SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar
 



 platforms.
 



 ● Strong expertise in keyword research, competitor analysis, SEO audits, and
 



 performance analysis.
 



 ● Strong knowledge of Technical SEO, crawling, indexing, redirects, canonicalization,
 



 structured data, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and Core Web Vitals.
 



 ● Experience with Google Business Profile and Local SEO.
 



 ● Strong understanding of content optimization and search intent.
 



 ● Ability to analyze data and convert insights into actionable SEO strategies.
 



 ● Strong communication and coordination skills.
 



 ● Ability to independently manage multiple SEO projects.
 



 ● Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
 



 ● Ability to work with developers and content teams for SEO implementation.
 



 Preferred Qualifications
 



 ● Experience working with WordPress, Shopify..
 



 ● Experience managing SEO for local and international websites.
 



 ● Experience with e\-commerce SEO is an advantage.
 



 ● Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, IT, or a related field is preferred.

title: Paid Ads Executive
description:
Role Overview
 
 We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented
 **Paid Ads Executive** 
 with around
 **1 year of hands\-on experience** 
 in managing and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as
 **Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads** 
 . The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of performance marketing, campaign optimization, audience targeting, and performance analysis.
 


 Responsibilities
 * Set up, manage, and monitor PPC campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
* Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, campaign structuring, and budget allocation.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize campaigns based on key metrics such as
 **CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and conversions** 
 .
* Analyze campaign data using
 **Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager** 
 , and other relevant tools.
* Perform A/B testing of ad creatives, ad copies, audiences, and campaign strategies.
* Identify performance trends and recommend improvements to achieve campaign objectives.
* Prepare weekly and monthly paid advertising performance reports.
* Conduct competitor analysis and market research to identify new opportunities.
* Coordinate with content, design, and SEO teams for ad creatives, landing pages, and campaign requirements.
* Maintain campaign documentation and ensure campaigns are aligned with client/business objectives.
* Stay updated with changes in advertising platforms, industry trends, and best practices.


 Qualifications
 * **1 year of hands\-on experience in Paid Ads / Performance Marketing.**
* Good understanding of
 **PPC, SEM, SMM, and digital marketing concepts** 
 .
* Practical experience with
 **Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager** 
 ; LinkedIn Ads experience is an advantage.
* Familiarity with
 **Google Analytics / GA4** 
 and campaign reporting tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of key performance metrics such as
 **CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rate** 
 .
* Good communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proactive attitude with a strong willingness to learn and improve campaign performance.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
